summary.zh: 每个火球术少半秒，强化火焰冲击缩短冷却并加射程，再点点燃，20 级拿炎爆术。
summary.en: Half a second off every Fireball, Improved Fire Blast for range and cooldown, then Ignite into Pyroblast at 20.

scenario.zh: 10–20 级，主用火球术与火焰冲击

pros.zh: 强化火球术让火球术与霜火箭的施法时间缩短 0.5 秒。
pros.en: Improved Fireball removes 0.5 seconds from Fireball and Frostfire Bolt.

pros.zh: 强化火焰冲击缩短火焰冲击冷却并延长射程，这正是点燃在此时值得投入的前提。
pros.en: Improved Fire Blast shortens the Fire Blast cooldown and extends its range, which is what makes Ignite worth taking this early.

pros.zh: 点燃让火焰暴击额外造成相当于该次伤害 24% 的燃烧，持续 4 秒。
pros.en: Ignite burns the target for an extra 24% of a Fire critical strike over 4 seconds.

pros.zh: 先点点燃再点强化火焰冲击是常见误区：没有更短冷却与更远射程，这个等级的火焰冲击暴击太少，点燃几乎不起作用。
pros.en: Taking Ignite before Improved Fire Blast is the common mistake: without the shorter cooldown and range, Fire Blast crits are too rare at this level for Ignite to do much.

provenance.source: wowhandbook.com recommended builds, beta client data
